The API and tests are in place: one bounded lineage read, literal matching with the existing mark normalization, and fresh results after privacy removal in both adapters. Results contain only approved text/runes and stop fields.

I’m tightening the form so it cannot fall back to putting a query in a URL, then updating the branch docs. The new search browser check will remain unverified until the parent runs it.

On "'`feature/raid-relic-shoulds`, **Where has my mark been?** searches shared approved text across completed stops only. It is **not** a viewer/account lookup or proof of personal ownership. Pending and privacy-removed marks are not searchable. This Should is not deployed: live sourcefd05/revision00003 stays frozen under the overriding owner directive. Should#1 was parent-verified223/223 plus pilot browser PASS and pushed asb0027e0; no new Should#2 browser pass is claimed. No Should#3 work is included.

The specific read-only **POST `/api/atlas/search`** accepts JSON query plus optional offset/limit (0–2560 /1–20), body≤1024 bytes and exact application/json. General Atlas POST still405, GET/query-string searches rejected. Query uses the existing one-word/one-emoji mark grammar, NFKC and case folding (including sharp-s/final sigma); literal substring matching, never a regex. Invalid arguments return generic400 before database work; public rate budget applies first. One bounded lineage document is read per request, at most16stops/160marks each, with no indexes, collection scans or polling. Results whitelist stopID/from/to/claim time/ring/text/rune, never actor/user/association fields or the query itself.

The client sends queries only in POST bodies, never navigation/history/storage/analytics/logs. Form input/submit enable only once preventDefault is wired, with a POST-only fallback. Responses are no-store; no durable search state/cache exists. Clear, input changes, failures, page exit/restore and Atlas refresh remove old results; each search/pagination request reads current surviving approved archive content. An already open page is a manual snapshot, not live erasure push. Forget/block/veto/opt-out purge source/archive content so future searches cannot resurrect it. Browser QA now exercises actual search, unchanged URL, keyboard submit and375px results; synthetic query fields are cleared before captures.

OAuth scopes stay **exactly unchanged**: Keeper `channel:bot channel:manage:raids`; bot `user:read:chat user:write:chat user:bot`. No onboarding/provider calls or viewer authentication is added. Latest sandbox **231 total/226pass/five EPERM socket skips/zero failures**, all223 baseline retained;42releasefiles and diff check pass. Parent review before any commit/push; no build/deploy/live/provider/credential/OpenAI calls.

Run the local mocked Atlas browser script above, or open its labelled Simulator Atlas on5191. In **Approved mark text (one word or emoji)** enter a shared approved word such as the fixture's synthetic moon mark; click **Search approved text** or press Enter. Matching completed stop links and approved rune/text are shown in pages≤20. Follow a stop link to existing detail navigation; **Clear search** removes the input/results. The script checks Unicode normalization, POST-only search without URL changes and375px results. Clear the synthetic query before capturing screenshots; do not collect real user queries.

This is shared-text discovery, **not verified personal ownership or a viewer/account association lookup**. Exact mark NFKC/case normalization and one-word/emoji bounds apply; substring matching is literal, not regex. Pending text and content erased by forget/block/veto/opt-out never appear in a fresh search. No-result/invalid/unavailable states clear old matches; manual requests read fresh data, without a query cache or polling. Browsers can retain displayed results until a clear/refresh/navigation; there is no claim of remote screenshot erasure.

The dedicated read-only POST endpoint accepts query/offset/limit in a≤1024-byte JSON body, never in URL/history/logs. It rate-limits before a single bounded lineage-document read. General Atlas POST stays405; malformed arguments fail400. Public result fields are only stop/channel/time/ring/approved-text/rune fields; no actor IDs, private association or OAuth data. Scopes are unchanged: Keepers channel:bot + channel:manage:raids; bot user:read:chat + user:write:chat + user:bot. No new authorization or provider traffic.

''' +s[idx:];p.write_text(s)

Owner live00003/sourcefd05 MUSTremain frozen; allprior build/redeploy authorizations still revoked. ''';p.write_text(s)

Implemented only Should #2 on `feature/raid-relic-shoulds`: bounded POST-only search of shared approved text across completed stops, with safe projections, privacy-erasure tests and transient client state.

**231 tests: 226 pass, 5 sandbox skips, 0 failures.** All 223 baseline tests retained; release inventory and diff checks pass.

Docs and local browser QA extended; host search-browser check remains pending. Live `fd05` stays frozen. No commit, push, build, deploy or provider calls.
